svg.title: Descriptions Decide Tool Choice
svg.desc: Two tools with one-line overlapping descriptions cause misrouting; rewritten descriptions that state purpose, inputs, outputs, examples and when to use the other tool make selection reliable.
svg.text: If two descriptions overlap, Claude can't tell the tools apart.
Account details: email, address, phone. Use for
Order status by order ID. Not for account data.
Keyword-heavy instructions can pull Claude to the wrong tool
